review_candidates.title: Maintenance Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Unipro for Contracting & Trading Co. specializes in the design, supply, installation, and maintenance of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) works. The company delivers integrated solutions that support the full lifecycle of building systems, from initial design through ongoing service. Projects typically span commercial, industrial, and residential facilities, providing exposure to diverse technologies and environments. Team members collaborate closely with engineers, technicians, and clients to ensure reliable, safe, and efficient operation of critical infrastructure. Role Description The Maintenance Engineer role at Unipro for Contracting & Trading Co. is an on-site position based in Alexandria. The Maintenance Engineer is responsible for inspecting, troubleshooting, and repairing MEP equipment and systems to ensure safe and continuous operation. Daily tasks include performing scheduled preventive maintenance, diagnosing faults, coordinating repairs, and documenting maintenance activities in accordance with company standards. The role involves working closely with project teams, supporting installation and commissioning activities when needed, and adhering to safety and regulatory requirements. The Maintenance Engineer will also contribute to continuous improvement by recommending technical enhancements and maintenance best practices. Qualifications Candidates should possess solid skills in Equipment Maintenance and Maintenance & Repair for MEP systems. Candidates should possess strong Maintenance Engineering capabilities, including fault diagnosis and system optimization. Candidates should possess experience in Preventive Maintenance planning, scheduling, and execution. Candidates should possess hands-on Electrical Maintenance skills for building services and related equipment. Relevant technical diploma or engineering degree (Mechanical, Electrical, or related field) is preferred. Knowledge of safety standards, permits to work, and compliance with local regulations is beneficial. Ability to read technical drawings and equipment manuals, with good problem-solving and analytical skills. Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively on-site in a fast-paced environment.

Role Description The Customer Service Assistant is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo. This role is responsible for handling customer inquiries, providing information about services and products, and ensuring timely and accurate responses via phone, email, and in person. The Customer Service Assistant will follow up on orders and projects, coordinate with internal teams to resolve issues, and update customer records and documentation. The role includes managing customer feedback, addressing complaints professionally, and supporting sales and operations teams with customer-related communication. Proficiency with basic office software and customer service tools; experience with CRM systems is an advantage. Previous experience in customer service, administrative support, or a client-facing role is preferred. Relevant diploma or bachelor’s degree in business, communications, or a related field is beneficial.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Xceed is a leading multilingual Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider in the EMEA region, operating more than 10,000 web-enabled multichannel stations. The company serves key government and commercial clients in 10 languages, delivering inbound, outbound, back office, infrastructure management, recruitment process outsourcing, helpdesk support, and social media analysis services. Xceed has sites in Egypt, Morocco, Mauritius, the UAE, and a new site in Saudi Arabia, offering diverse regional exposure for team members. Requirements: - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. - Minimum 4 years of software development experience, including 2+ years in a senior or leadership role. - Strong experience with C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and REST APIs. - Experience with PostgreSQL or SQL Server. - Good knowledge of React or Angular. - Experience with Git, Docker, CI/CD, and Agile methodologies. - Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants and LLM integration is a strong advantage. - Strong leadership, mentoring, communication, and problem-solving skills. - Fluent in English.
